metadata.title: Can't Place a Cow on Pasture

messages.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm really interested in the Kaggriculture competition, but I've been stuck on one issue for a while: I can't seem to place a cow on a pasture.

Could anyone let me know if I'm missing a step? Here's what I've done:

  1. Purchased a cow (it's in my inventory).
  2. Built two pasture blocks.
  3. Tried to place the cow on the pasture.

I also tried hiring a worker and having the worker stand on the same block as the pasture with me, or on a different block to place, but it still doesn't work.

Has anyone else run into this issue, or is there another requirement that I'm overlooking?

Thanks in advance for any advice!
Hello, you need to pick up cow from your inventory before placing it. So, the process is: BUY - PICK UP - BUILD PASTURE - PLACE.
I got stuck for so long. Thank you sooo much! That really helps

Good evening Becca Jr!

Was it mentioned in the specification? If you don't mind, making your code public would make it easier for people to give you specific advice!
